mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship is consistent across historical data and is not contingent on specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals economic weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in both the housing sector and manufacturing, which typically precedes a bearish equity market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction signal (both HOUST and INDPRO declining) and 60-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve typically initiates monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000, signals robust economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 200000 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which typically boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong retail sales figure (RSAFS) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals robust consumer spending and accommodative monetary policy, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction signal (RSAFS above 90th percentile and FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) and 5-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) figure exceeding 1,200,000 units signals a strong housing market that supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1200 over a 2-year rolling window.
